scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix worker run lint
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix worker run build
scripts.test: node scripts/check-mini-ping-toggle.mjs && node scripts/check-instance-chart-range.mjs && node scripts/check-website-monitor-period-loading.mjs && node scripts/check-ping-chart-failed-series.mjs && node scripts/check-theme-active-default.mjs && node scripts/check-demo-reset-safeupdate.mjs && node scripts/check-backup-restore-safeupdate.mjs && node scripts/check-region-count-country.mjs && node scripts/check-agent-ws-query-token.mjs && node scripts/check-agent-install-token-persistence.mjs && node scripts/check-agent-website-probes.mjs && cd agent && go test ./...
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build && npm test

SUPABASE_URL.description: Supabase Project URL, for example `https://PROJECT_REF.supabase.co`. Find it in Supabase **Project Settings** -> **API**.

SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.description: Supabase secret/service role key. Store it as a Worker secret; never expose it in frontend code.

JWT_SECRET.description: Admin session signing secret. Use a random string with at least 32 characters.

DEMO_RESET_ENABLED.description: Optional. Set to `true` only for public demo sites that should restore the saved demo snapshot every 30 minutes.
